title: RDR2 crash: ERR_GFX_D3D_DEFERRED_MEM (DirectX 12)
summary: The game ran out of graphics memory while starting up on DirectX 12. It usually isn't your VRAM size — it's a driver, overclock, or API problem.
cause: DirectX 12 in RDR2 is sensitive to unstable GPU overclocks and fresh driver bugs. A new driver install or an overclock that is stable in other games can still trigger this error at launch.
steps: Remove any GPU overclock. Reset to default in MSI Afterburner (or your tuning tool), or close the tool completely before launching.

Switch the graphics API to Vulkan. If you can't reach the menu, edit Documents\Rockstar Games\Red Dead Redemption 2\Settings\system.xml and change <API>kSettingAPI_DX12</API> to <API>kSettingAPI_Vulkan</API>.
If the error started right after a driver update, do a clean install of the previous driver version (use the 'clean install' option, or DDU in Safe Mode).
Make sure Windows virtual memory (page file) is set to 'System managed size' with free space on that drive.
Close background overlays (Afterburner/RivaTuner, recording tools) and test again.
ifStillBroken: Verify game files in your launcher. If it still fails on both DX12 and Vulkan, see the Vulkan memory error fix below.

title: RDR2 crash: "Failed to allocate memory for Vulkan"
patterns: failed to allocate memory for vulkan
summary: The Vulkan renderer couldn't reserve the memory it asked for. Most often caused by a driver issue, an unstable overclock, or leftover processes holding memory.
cause: Vulkan reports memory failures more bluntly than DirectX. Corrupt shader caches, a just-released driver, or an overclock on the memory clock are the usual triggers — not a lack of VRAM.
steps: Reset GPU core and memory overclocks to stock.
Restart the PC (not just the game) so nothing is holding GPU memory. Check Task Manager > Performance > GPU: dedicated memory should be low with the game closed.
Delete the shader cache: in Documents\Rockstar Games\Red Dead Redemption 2\Settings, remove the sga_* files (the game rebuilds them).
Roll back to the previous graphics driver with a clean install if the error began after an update.
Lower Texture Quality one step to rule out genuine VRAM pressure.
ifStillBroken: Try DirectX 12 instead. If both APIs fail, run a GPU memory stress test (e.g. OCCT VRAM test) to rule out hardware.

title: RedM won't load or hangs after RDR2 works fine
summary: Single-player RDR2 runs, but RedM crashes or hangs. Usually leftover launcher processes, a cloud-synced install folder, or a corrupt cache.
cause: RedM needs the Rockstar launcher in a clean state and its own cache intact. OneDrive syncing the game or RedM folder can lock files mid-load.
steps: Fully close RDR2, the Rockstar Games Launcher, and any leftover Rockstar/Social Club processes in Task Manager.
Make sure RedM and RDR2 are not installed inside a OneDrive-synced folder (Documents/Desktop can be synced). Move them to a normal folder like C:\Games.
Clear RedM's cache: open the RedM Application Data folder and delete the 'data\cache', 'data\server-cache' and 'data\server-cache-priv' folders. Do not delete citizen or the main data files.
Launch RDR2 single-player once to confirm it loads, close it, then start RedM.
ifStillBroken: Add your antivirus exclusions for the RedM and RDR2 folders, then try again.
